description: This file defines the CallManager class responsible for managing voice call states, interactions with a provider, and handling call lifecycle events in a voice call application.

classes.name: CallManager
classes.description: Manages voice calls, including state, lifecycle, and interactions with external provider and modules.

methods.name: initialize
methods.description: Initializes the call manager with a provider, verifies persisted calls, and restarts timers.

methods.name: verifyRestoredCalls
methods.description: Verifies persisted calls with the provider before restoring them.

methods.name: getProvider
methods.description: Returns the current voice call provider.

methods.name: speak
methods.description: Speaks a message to a specific call.

methods.name: speakInitialMessage
methods.description: Speaks the initial message for a call when media connects.

methods.name: continueCall
methods.description: Continues a call by speaking a prompt and waiting for user input.

methods.name: getCall
methods.description: Retrieves a call record by call ID.

methods.name: getCallByProviderCallId
methods.description: Retrieves a call record by provider call ID.

methods.name: processEvent
methods.description: Processes a webhook event related to call state changes.
